# Labeling

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

The names that a product gives to its content and its functions. Rosenfeld, Morville, and Arango make labeling one of the systems of an information architecture. A label can be a contextual link, a heading, a choice in a navigation system, an index term, or an icon.
